en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Hamdan Bin Suleyman, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Al Waleed, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who intends to boost his wealth, so let him prolong the pausing upon Al-Safa and Al-Marwa’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Hamdan ibn Sulayman from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn al-Walid in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one who wants his wealth increase should stay on al- Safa’ and al-Marwah for a long time.”
